pages.text: Tetrium, Magnatite and Illyrium melt in a Tinkers' smeltery or a Thermal Magma Crucible, and pipe and store like any fluid. A nugget is 10 mB and an ingot 90 mB, and both cast back one for one.$(br2)Ore melts to exactly what the BSP machines make from it: Tetrium ore 20 mB, two nuggets; Magnatite ore 30 mB, three. The slag and the Carbon Dust come only from the BSP machines.$(br2)Illyrium ore, Dirty Illyrium and Charged Magnatite do not melt: the Crucible, the Refinery and the Centrifuge are their only way.

Spilled, molten metal burns whatever wades into it, as lava does, and meets water as lava does: a still pool sets to $(item)Obsidian$(), a flowing edge to $(item)Cobblestone$(), and the metal is gone.$(br2)A dispenser pours a molten bucket, and fills an empty one from a pool in front of it.
